articles.summary: Higher Treasury yields and shifting Fed expectations weighed on taxable fixed income markets in July. Treasurys, investment grade corporates and securitized sectors all declined, while credit spreads remained relatively contained and issuance stayed strong.
articles.title: Taxable Fixed Income Markets Update: July 2026
